scenes.say: React apps can get slow fast. How do you make them snappy for users and interviewers?

scenes.label: Memoize
scenes.sub: useMemo and useCallback prevent wasteful re-renders.
scenes.say: Memoization with useMemo and useCallback stops unnecessary recalculations and re-renders.
Lazy loading with React dot lazy loads components only when needed, shrinking your initial bundle.
Memoization caches expensive calculations. Lazy loading cuts bundle size by loading components on demand.

scenes.question: When does useMemo recalculate?
scenes.right: Only when dependencies change, not every render.
scenes.say: Interview trap: useMemo only recalculates when its dependencies change, not every render.
